title: Дискурсивные маркеры в речи и письме: in fact, mind you, as it happens, after all

why: Дискурсивные маркеры — это «связки» речи: они показывают, как ваша фраза относится к предыдущей (уточнение, уступка, причина, смена темы). Они делают речь живой и похожей на речь носителя; в русском их роль играют «вообще-то», «кстати», «впрочем», «в конце концов», «так уж вышло».
formation: Маркер обычно стоит в начале предложения или в конце и отделяется запятой: In fact, ... / ..., after all. Это не меняет порядок слов в самом предложении.
• in fact / as a matter of fact — «на самом деле», усиливают или уточняют
• as it happens — «так уж вышло», совпадение
• after all — «в конце концов», напоминание о причине (или результат вопреки ожиданию в конце)
• anyway — «ладно, в любом случае», возврат к теме или завершение
usage: 1. Усиление и уточнение: The test wasn't difficult. In fact, it was very easy. (Тест был не сложный. Вообще-то, очень лёгкий.)
2. Поправка: A: You're from Russia? B: Actually, I'm from Ukraine. (Вообще-то я из Украины.)
3. Уступка: The flat is small. Mind you, it's in a great area. (Квартира маленькая. Впрочем, район отличный.)
4. Совпадение: As it happens, I know the author. (Так уж вышло, что я знаком с автором.)
5. Напоминание о причине: Don't be angry. He's a beginner, after all. (Не злись. Он же новичок.) Либо результат вопреки ожиданиям: I passed after all. (Я всё-таки сдал.)
6. Смена и возврат темы: By the way, have you seen Tom? Anyway, let's get back to work.
signalWords: though / but (рядом с mind you), expected / thought (рядом с after all), no, ... (перед actually), the reason (перед after all).
mistakes: ✗ Actually, we have ten developers (имеется в виду «сейчас») → ✓ Currently, we have ten developers (actually не значит «актуально, в данный момент»).
✗ After all, I found the keys (имеется в виду «наконец») → ✓ In the end, I found the keys (after all не значит «в итоге после всего»).
✗ To say honestly, ... → ✓ To be honest, ... (устойчивое выражение).
✗ In the way, ... → ✓ By the way, ... (кстати).
✗ Any way, let's move on → ✓ Anyway, let's move on (одним словом).
remember: Actually и in fact — «на самом деле», mind you — «впрочем», after all — «ведь / всё-таки», by the way — «кстати»; а «сейчас» по-английски — currently.

exercises.instruction: Вставьте подходящий маркер (in fact, mind you, as it happens, after all, by the way, to be honest, anyway, actually)

items.prompt: We shouldn't be angry. She is only a child, ___.
items.answer: after all

items.prompt: A: Who is the new manager? B: ___, I used to work with her.
items.answer: As it happens

items.prompt: It's an old laptop. ___, it still works well.
items.answer: Mind you

items.prompt: ___, have you seen Tom today?
items.answer: By the way

items.prompt: A: You're from Russia? B: No, ___, I'm Ukrainian.
items.answer: actually

items.prompt: She isn't just good. ___, she's the best in the company.
items.answer: In fact / As a matter of fact

items.prompt: ...so that's the history of the project. ___, let's discuss the next steps.
items.answer: Anyway

items.prompt: ___, I'm not a big fan of morning meetings.
items.answer: To be honest

items.prompt: I wasn't surprised he won. (a) Mind you, (b) After all, he'd practiced every day.
items.answer: (b) After all

items.prompt: The food was terrible. (a) Mind you, (b) After all, the service was friendly.
items.answer: (a) Mind you

items.prompt: A: Do you need a lift? B: (a) As it happens, (b) After all, I'm going that way anyway.
items.answer: (a) As it happens

items.prompt: (a) By the way, (b) Anyway, enough about me. How was your trip?
items.answer: (b) Anyway

items.prompt: A: You look tired. B: (a) Actually, (b) After all, I slept really well.
items.answer: (a) Actually

items.prompt: We planned to go out, but we stayed home (a) in fact (b) after all.
items.answer: (b) after all

items.prompt: The project is late. (a) Mind you, (b) In fact, we haven't even started.
items.answer: (b) In fact

items.prompt: (a) By the way, (b) After all, I forgot to tell you: the meeting is moved to Friday.
items.answer: (a) By the way

exercises.instruction: Перепишите или дополните предложение с указанным маркером

items.prompt: Add 'as it happens' at the start: I live next door to the manager.
items.answer: As it happens, I live next door to the manager.

items.prompt: Join with 'After all': You can't blame him. He is only a beginner.
items.answer: You can't blame him. After all, he is only a beginner.

items.prompt: Add 'mind you' at the start of the second sentence: The salary is low. The team is great.
items.answer: The salary is low. Mind you, the team is great.

items.prompt: Add 'In fact' at the start of the second sentence: The test was not difficult. It was very easy.
items.answer: The test was not difficult. In fact, it was very easy.

items.prompt: Use 'after all' at the end: We planned to cancel the trip, but we went.
items.answer: We planned to cancel the trip, but we went after all.

items.prompt: Change the topic with 'by the way': Do you have Sarah's number?
items.answer: By the way, do you have Sarah's number?

items.prompt: Soften your opinion with 'to be honest': I don't like the design.
items.answer: To be honest, I don't like the design.

items.prompt: Return to the main topic with 'anyway': Let's move on to the next slide.
items.answer: Anyway, let's move on to the next slide.

exercises.instruction: Найдите и исправьте ошибку в маркере

items.prompt: Actually, we have ten developers in the team. (имеется в виду «в данный момент»)
items.answer: Currently, we have ten developers in the team.

items.prompt: After all, I found my keys. (имеется в виду «наконец»)
items.answer: In the end, I found my keys.

items.prompt: To say honestly, I don't like it.
items.answer: To be honest, I don't like it.

items.prompt: How it happens, I know his brother.
items.answer: As it happens, I know his brother.

items.prompt: In the way, do you know where Tom is?
items.answer: By the way, do you know where Tom is?

items.prompt: Any way, let's move on.
items.answer: Anyway, let's move on.

items.prompt: Mind that, it was cheap.
items.answer: Mind you, it was cheap.

items.prompt: In the fact, the app is very fast.
items.answer: In fact, the app is very fast.

items.prompt: Честно говоря, я не очень люблю созвоны по утрам.
items.answer: To be honest, I'm not a big fan of morning calls.

items.prompt: Кстати, ты уже отправил счёт?
items.answer: By the way, have you sent the invoice yet?

items.prompt: Не переживай из-за ошибки. В конце концов, это тестовая среда.
items.answer: Don't worry about the mistake. After all, it's a test environment.

items.prompt: Вообще-то я родом из Харькова.
items.answer: Actually, I'm from Kharkiv. / As a matter of fact, I'm from Kharkiv.

items.prompt: Так уж вышло, что я знаком с автором этой библиотеки.
items.answer: As it happens, I know the author of this library.

items.prompt: Квартира маленькая. Впрочем, она в отличном районе.
items.answer: The apartment is small. Mind you, it's in a great neighborhood.

items.prompt: Ладно, давайте вернёмся к бюджету.
items.answer: Anyway, let's get back to the budget.

items.prompt: Я думал, что провалю собеседование, но всё-таки прошёл.
items.answer: I thought I'd fail the interview, but I passed after all.
